THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Order under Proviso (a) to Section 38
Order No. 23 of 2025
My Ref. No.: 4-3/7/2023/HW/90. Divisional Secretary's Ref. No.: CODS/LA/3/HW/30A.

BY virtue of the powers vested in me by Proviso (a) to Section 38 of the Land Acquisition Act (Chapter 460), I, Kuragamage Don Lal Kantha, Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation, do hereby direct the Acquiring Oﬃ cer or any other oﬃ cer authorized by him referred to in Paragraph 1 of the Schedule to take immediate possession of the land speciﬁ ed in the corresponding entry in Paragraph 2 of that Schedule.
K. D. Lal Kantha, Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation.
Ministry of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation,“Mihikatha Medura”,No.1200/06, Rajamalwatta Road,Battaramulla.27th February, 2025.
SCHEDULE
1. Acquiring Oﬃ cer.- Divisional Secretary, Colombo.

2. Description of the Land.- The allotments of below mentioned land Lots depicted in the Advance Tracing No. CO/COL/2023/599 dated 07.03.2024, prepared by the Surveyor General, situated in the Village called Galleface (Within the limits of Colombo Municipal Council) in Grama Niladhari Division of Galleface in the Divisional Secretary's Division of Colombo in Colombo District in the Western Province and described in below names and extents as follows:

1. Lot A - Assessment No. Cannot be found, Justice Akbar Mawatha – Extent: 0.0067 Hectare North: The land claimed by the Colombo Municipal Council, where the Assessment No. cannot be found on Justice Akbar Mawatha and Road; East: Road and Justice Akbar Mawatha; South: Justice Akbar Mawatha; West: Justice Akbar Mawatha, The land claimed by Waterfront Integrated Resort Cannot be found Assessment No. in Justice Akbar Mawatha and The land claimed by the Colombo Municipal Council.
